name: Smithing Tuyere
summary: The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool stolen by Dark Iron dwarves in Searing Gorge. The Thorium Brotherhood wants it returned to Taskmaster Scrange.

sections.title: A Stolen Tool
sections.body: The Thorium Brotherhood seeks the Smithing Tuyere in Searing Gorge, where Dark Iron dwarves have stolen it. The tool belongs to a smith's forge. Air blown through its tube makes a furnace burn hotter, helping metal grow soft enough to work.

faq.answer: A Smithing Tuyere is a tube that blows air into a furnace, making its fire hotter so metal can be worked.
The Thorium Brotherhood believes Dark Iron dwarves in Searing Gorge stole the Smithing Tuyere.
The Thorium Brotherhood wants the Smithing Tuyere returned to Taskmaster Scrange in Searing Gorge.
The Smithing Tuyere was stolen by Dark Iron dwarves in Searing Gorge.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you know a tuyere feeds air into a furnace, making its fire hot enough to work metal.
